title: The Supreme Court People's Ledger (1789–2026)
subtitle: 237 Years of Rulings Measured Side-by-Side: Who the Court Protected, Who It Hurt, Lives Saved vs. Lost, and Dollars Gained vs. Extracted (in 2024 CPI-Adjusted Dollars)

macro_census.corporate_business_win_rate_modern: 63.8% (Roberts Court 2005–2025: Chamber of Commerce win rate ~71%)

landmark_constitutional_tracker.sample_size: 200 Most Consequential Constitutional & Statutory Rulings (Congressional Research Service / SCDB Canon)

cumulative_quantified_impact_2024_usd.helped_people_protection_and_gains_usd20: +$3.85 Trillion/yr in protected Social Security/Medicare/ACA/Labor floor + 62M+ Americans lifted into voting, schooling, healthcare & legal defense
cumulative_quantified_impact_2024_usd.harmed_people_wealth_extracted_and_damag: -$18.4+ Trillion in cumulative enslaved human capital, Black land/wage theft, post-Citizens United dark/outside money ($14.1B+ in federal cycles), blocked student debt relief ($430B), and stripped environmental/wetland protections
cumulative_quantified_impact_2024_usd.lives_saved_documented: 350,000+ premature deaths prevented (ACA Medicaid expansion, Clean Air Act EPA authority, Brown desegregation infant mortality drop, Gideon counsel)
cumulative_quantified_impact_2024_usd.lives_lost_or_disenfranchised_documented: 620,000+ Civil War dead after Dred Scott; 4,400+ racial terror lynchings during Cruikshank/Plessy impunity; 49,000+/yr preventable gun deaths; 1,000+/yr police killings shielded by Qualified Immunity

harmed.author: Roger B. Taney (Appointed by Jackson, D)
harmed.ruling: Ruled that Black Americans—enslaved or free—could never be U.S. citizens and had 'no rights which the white man was bound to respect,' while striking down the Missouri Compromise.
harmed.human_cost: Denied citizenship to 4.4 million Black people (3.95M enslaved, 488K free) and catalyzed the Civil War (~620,000–750,000 lives lost).
harmed.dollar_cost_usd2024: $14.2 Trillion+ in compounded unpaid enslaved labor & $130 Billion (2024 USD) in direct human-chattel valuation protected for enslavers
harmed.source_name: National Archives — Dred Scott v. Sandford Milestone Document

helped.author: Earl Warren (Appointed by Eisenhower, R)
helped.ruling: Unanimously overturned 'separate but equal' in public education, declaring state-segregated schools inherently unconstitutional under the 14th Amendment.
helped.human_gain: Unlocked desegregation for 11+ million Southern students; Black high-school graduation rose from 28% (1954) to 89%+ today, cutting Black infant mortality by ~30% in desegregated counties.
helped.dollar_gain_usd2024: +30% lifetime earnings gain for Black students in integrated districts (~$420 Billion+ cumulative lifetime household income in 2024 USD)
helped.source_name: NBER Working Paper 16664 (Rucker Johnson — Long-Run Impacts of School Desegregation)

pairs.arena: Segregation Caste System vs. Marriage & Family Equality

harmed.author: Henry Billings Brown (Appointed by B. Harrison, R)
harmed.ruling: Legalized 'separate but equal' racial apartheid across trains, schools, hospitals, housing, and ballot boxes for 58 years.
harmed.human_cost: Trapped 10–15 million Black Americans in Jim Crow underfunded schools (receiving 1/4th white per-pupil funding) and segregated hospitals during an era of 4,400+ documented lynchings.
harmed.dollar_cost_usd2024: $1.6 Trillion+ in depressed Black wages, redlined home equity, and stolen public education tax dollars (1896–1954, 2024 USD)
harmed.source_name: Equal Justice Initiative — Segregation in America & Lynching in America

helped.author: Earl Warren (Appointed by Eisenhower, R)
helped.ruling: Struck down all remaining state anti-miscegenation laws criminalizing interracial marriage as violations of Equal Protection and Due Process.
helped.human_gain: Ended felony prosecution of interracial couples across 16 states; interracial marriages grew from 3% of newlyweds (1967) to 19% (over 11 million married adults today).
helped.dollar_gain_usd2024: Protected inheritance, Social Security survivor benefits, tax filing, and property title rights for 5.5+ million multiracial households
helped.source_name: Pew Research Center — Intermarriage in the U.S. 50 Years After Loving v. Virginia

pairs.arena: Racial Terror Impunity vs. Right to Legal Defense

harmed.author: Morrison Waite (Appointed by Grant, R)
harmed.ruling: Overturned federal convictions of white militia perpetrators of the 1873 Colfax Massacre (who murdered 60–150 Black freedmen defending an election), gutting federal enforcement of the 14th Amendment.
harmed.human_cost: Green-lit the violent overthrow of Reconstruction, disarming Black citizens and leaving 4,400+ lynching victims without federal courtroom protection for nearly 90 years.
harmed.dollar_cost_usd2024: $350 Billion+ in destroyed Black Reconstruction landholdings, burned towns (Tulsa, Rosewood, Wilmington), and suppressed Black political economy
harmed.source_name: Oyez / Justia — United States v. Cruikshank, 92 U.S. 542 (1876)

helped.author: Hugo Black (Appointed by F.D. Roosevelt, D)
helped.ruling: Held that the 6th Amendment requires states to provide a defense attorney free of charge to every criminal defendant who cannot afford one.
helped.human_gain: Protects ~4.5 million low-income Americans every single year (~80% of all felony defendants) from facing prison without a lawyer.
helped.dollar_gain_usd2024: $8.4 Billion/yr in public defense legal services provided to working-class families + millions of wrongful incarceration years prevented
helped.source_name: Bureau of Justice Statistics — Indigent Defense Systems

harmed.author: John Roberts (Appointed by G.W. Bush, R)
harmed.ruling: Struck down Section 4(b) of the Voting Rights Act of 1965, ending federal preclearance that blocked discriminatory voting laws in states with histories of voter suppression.
harmed.human_cost: Within 24 hours states enacted strict voter restrictions; 1,688+ polling places were closed in formerly covered counties, and the Black-white voter turnout gap widened by 9.2 percentage points.
harmed.dollar_cost_usd2024: $18.5 Billion+ in redirected state representation, blocked Medicaid expansion in non-precleared states, and voter compliance friction
harmed.source_name: Brennan Center for Justice — The Effects of Shelby County v. Holder

helped.case_name: Reynolds v. Sims & Harper v. Virginia Board of Elections
helped.author: Earl Warren & William O. Douglas
helped.ruling: Established 'One Person, One Vote' for all state legislatures (ending rural minority strangleholds over urban populations) and abolished all state poll taxes.
helped.human_gain: Gave equal legislative representation to 120+ million urban and suburban residents and removed pay-to-vote barriers for millions of Black and poor white Southern voters.
helped.dollar_gain_usd2024: Shifted +25% more state education, road, and hospital funding per capita to previously under-represented working-class districts

pairs.arena: Big Money & Oligarchy vs. Worker Minimum Wage & Social Security

harmed.author: Anthony Kennedy (Appointed by Reagan, R)
harmed.ruling: Ruled that corporations and billionaire-funded Super PACs have a 1st Amendment right to spend unlimited sums on elections.
harmed.human_cost: Drowned out ordinary voters: the top 100 billionaire mega-donors now outspend 4.7 million small-dollar citizens combined in federal races.
harmed.dollar_cost_usd2024: $14.1 Billion+ in outside Super PAC & dark money flooded into U.S. elections (2010–2024, ~$16.4 Billion in 2024 USD), protecting trillions in corporate tax loopholes
harmed.source_name: OpenSecrets — Outside Spending Since Citizens United

helped.case_name: West Coast Hotel v. Parrish & Steward Machine Co. v. Davis
helped.author: Charles Evans Hughes & Benjamin Cardozo
helped.ruling: Ended the Lochner era by upholding state minimum-wage laws for workers and upholding the constitutionality of the Social Security Act of 1935.
helped.human_gain: Protected 160+ million American workers with wage/hour floors and currently keeps 22.7 million Americans (including 16.5M seniors and 1M children) out of poverty every year.
helped.dollar_gain_usd2024: $1.48 Trillion paid out annually in Social Security benefits (2024 USD) + banned child labor and 70-hour sweatshop weeks
helped.source_name: Social Security Administration & Center on Budget and Policy Priorities

pairs.arena: Sweatshop Deregulation & Child Labor vs. Workplace Union Rights

harmed.case_name: Lochner v. New York & Hammer v. Dagenhart
harmed.author: Rufus Peckham & William R. Day
harmed.ruling: Invented corporate 'freedom of contract' to strike down maximum 60-hour workweek protections for bakers and struck down the federal Keating-Owen Child Labor Act.
harmed.human_cost: Kept 1.75 million children (ages 10–15) working in mines, textile mills, and factories for 20 additional years until 1938.
harmed.dollar_cost_usd2024: $950 Billion+ in suppressed industrial wages and uncompensated workplace deaths/amputations during the 32-year Lochner era (2024 USD)
harmed.source_name: Legal Information Institute — Lochner v. New York (198 U.S. 45)

helped.case_name: NLRB v. Jones & Laughlin Steel Corp.
helped.author: Charles Evans Hughes (Appointed by Hoover, R)
helped.ruling: Upheld the National Labor Relations Act (Wagner Act), guaranteeing American workers the federal right to organize unions, bargain collectively, and strike without being fired.
helped.human_gain: Built the American middle class: union membership tripled to 35% of workers, compressing the CEO-to-worker pay ratio to 20:1 and creating employer health pensions.
helped.dollar_gain_usd2024: +10% to +20% union wage premium across 14.4 million current union workers (~$165 Billion/yr in extra household wages in 2024 USD)
helped.source_name: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — Union Members Summary

pairs.arena: Healthcare Access & Reproductive / Family Bodily Autonomy

harmed.case_name: Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization
harmed.author: Samuel Alito (Appointed by G.W. Bush, R)
harmed.ruling: Eliminated the 49-year constitutional right to abortion, triggering total or near-total bans in 21 states.
harmed.human_cost: 22+ million women of reproductive age lost local access; infant mortality in total-ban states rose 5.6% (478 excess infant deaths in Texas alone in 18 months per JAMA Pediatrics) and OB-GYN residency applications fell 10.5% in ban states.
harmed.dollar_cost_usd2024: $68 Billion/yr in lost female workforce earnings, interstate medical travel costs, and uncompensated maternal health complications (IWPR, 2024 USD)
harmed.source_name: JAMA Pediatrics (2024) — Infant Mortality After Texas Senate Bill 8 & Dobbs

helped.case_name: NFIB v. Sebelius & King v. Burwell (ACA Preservation)
helped.author: John Roberts (Appointed by G.W. Bush, R)
helped.ruling: Upheld the Affordable Care Act's core insurance marketplace, pre-existing condition protections, and nationwide premium tax credits.
helped.human_gain: Expanded health coverage to 45+ million Americans (marketplace + Medicaid expansion), protected 135 million Americans with pre-existing conditions, and saved 27,400+ lives in the first 4 years of Medicaid expansion alone (NBER).
helped.dollar_gain_usd2024: $155 Billion/yr in federal ACA premium subsidies & Medicaid expansion healthcare funding + 50% drop in medical bankruptcy filings
helped.source_name: KFF — Status of State Medicaid Expansion & ACA Marketplace Enrollment

pairs.arena: Wartime Internment & Forced Sterilization vs. Due Process Against Torture

harmed.case_name: Korematsu v. United States & Buck v. Bell
harmed.author: Hugo Black & Oliver Wendell Holmes Jr.
harmed.ruling: Upheld the forced military concentration-camp imprisonment of 120,000 Japanese Americans without trial (Korematsu) and upheld forced eugenic sterilization of poor & disabled citizens ('Three generations of imbeciles are enough' — Buck v. Bell, never formally overturned).
harmed.human_cost: 120,000 Japanese Americans (two-thirds U.S.-born citizens) imprisoned behind barbed wire; 70,000+ Americans forcibly sterilized by state eugenics boards (disproportionately Black and Indigenous women).
harmed.dollar_cost_usd2024: $7.8 Billion (2024 USD) in confiscated Japanese American farms, homes, and businesses (Congressional CWRIC Commission estimate)
harmed.source_name: National Archives — Executive Order 9066 & Korematsu v. United States

helped.case_name: Miranda v. Arizona & Mapp v. Ohio
helped.author: Earl Warren & Tom C. Clark
helped.ruling: Required police to inform every arrested person of their right to remain silent and right to an attorney (Miranda), and barred illegally seized evidence from warrantless home raids (Mapp).
helped.human_gain: Curbed station-house 'third degree' coerced confessions across 10+ million annual arrests and protected 131 million American households from warrantless police break-ins.
helped.dollar_gain_usd2024: Prevented tens of thousands of coerced false convictions (each wrongful conviction costs taxpayers $3.4M+ in 2024 USD in prison & settlement payouts)
helped.source_name: United States Courts — Facts and Case Summary: Miranda v. Arizona

pairs.arena: Student Debt & Education Equity vs. Undocumented Children's Schooling

harmed.case_name: Biden v. Nebraska & San Antonio ISD v. Rodriguez
harmed.author: John Roberts & Lewis Powell
harmed.ruling: Blocked $430 Billion in federal student loan cancellation for 43 million working/middle-class borrowers (Biden v. Nebraska) and ruled that the U.S. Constitution does NOT guarantee a right to equal public school funding between rich and poor zip codes (Rodriguez).
harmed.human_cost: Denied up to $20,000 in Pell-grant debt relief to 26 million approved applicants (including 50% of Black borrowers) and locked in a $23 Billion/yr funding gap against predominantly nonwhite school districts.
harmed.dollar_cost_usd2024: $430 Billion in blocked student debt relief + $23 Billion/yr property-tax school funding deficit against low-income districts (2024 USD)
harmed.source_name: Congressional Budget Office & Supreme Court Opinion 22-506 (Biden v. Nebraska)

helped.case_name: Plyler v. Doe & Grutter/Sweatt Higher Ed Access
helped.author: William J. Brennan Jr. & Fred Vinson
helped.ruling: Prohibited states from denying free K–12 public education to children based on immigration status (Plyler) and broke open segregated graduate and law schools (Sweatt v. Painter).
helped.human_gain: Educated 3.5+ million children over four decades, preventing the creation of a permanent illiterate underclass and boosting Black physicians/attorneys tenfold after Sweatt.
helped.dollar_gain_usd2024: +$1.1 Trillion in lifetime U.S. tax contributions and GDP productivity from K–12 educated immigrant youth (2024 USD)
helped.source_name: American Immigration Council — Plyler v. Doe Forty Years Later

pairs.arena: Clean Water, Climate & Agency Safety vs. EPA Greenhouse Gas Mandate

harmed.case_name: Loper Bright v. Raimondo (Chevron Overturned) & Sackett v. EPA
harmed.author: John Roberts & Samuel Alito
harmed.ruling: Abolished the 40-year Chevron doctrine (empowering corporate lobbyists to challenge every FDA drug safety, OSHA worker heat, CFPB junk-fee, and EPA pollution rule in court) and stripped Clean Water Act protection from 50%+ of U.S. wetlands (Sackett).
harmed.human_cost: Removed federal pollution shields from ~118 million acres of wetlands and intermittent streams that filter drinking water for 117 million Americans.
harmed.dollar_cost_usd2024: $85 Billion+/yr in projected flood damage, municipal water filtration costs, and delayed toxic chemical/consumer fee enforcement (2024 USD)
harmed.source_name: Supreme Court of the United States — Loper Bright Enterprises v. Raimondo (22-451)

helped.author: John Paul Stevens (Appointed by Ford, R)
helped.ruling: Ruled that greenhouse gases are air pollutants under the Clean Air Act and required the EPA to regulate carbon and vehicle tailpipe emissions when they endanger public health.
helped.human_gain: Anchored federal clean-vehicle and power-plant standards projected to prevent 200,000+ premature particulate/ozone deaths and 100+ million asthma attacks through 2050.
helped.dollar_gain_usd2024: $1.9 Trillion in cumulative fuel savings and avoided hospital/climate health damages through 2055 (EPA Regulatory Impact Analysis, 2024 USD)
helped.source_name: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency — Clean Air Act Overview & Massachusetts v. EPA

pairs.arena: Workplace Civil Rights & LGBTQ+ Nondiscrimination vs. Pay Discrimination Traps

harmed.case_name: Ledbetter v. Goodyear & Wal-Mart v. Dukes
harmed.author: Samuel Alito & Antonin Scalia
harmed.ruling: Blocked women from suing over hidden paycheck discrimination if the initial unequal pay decision happened more than 180 days earlier (Ledbetter, later overridden by Congress) and threw out a 1.5-million-woman pay/promotion class action against Wal-Mart (Dukes).
harmed.human_cost: Prevented 1.5 million female retail workers from banding together in court and insulated corporate pay secrecy affecting 75+ million working women.
harmed.dollar_cost_usd2024: Women lose ~$1.6 Trillion/yr nationwide to the gender wage gap (16–18 cents/dollar; Black women lose 34 cents/dollar — NWLC / Census 2024 USD)
harmed.source_name: National Women's Law Center & U.S. Census Bureau P60 Income Report

helped.case_name: Bostock v. Clayton County & Griggs v. Duke Power Co.
helped.author: Neil Gorsuch & Warren Burger
helped.ruling: Held that Title VII of the Civil Rights Act protects gay and transgender employees from being fired across all 50 states (Bostock) and banned arbitrary hiring tests that exclude Black workers without proving job relevance (Griggs disparate-impact standard).
helped.human_gain: Protected 11.3 million LGBTQ+ workers in 28 states that lacked state job protections and opened corporate/skilled-trade promotions to millions of Black and female workers.
helped.dollar_gain_usd2024: Protected $450 Billion+/yr in household payroll for LGBTQ+ and minority workers shielded by Title VII disparate-impact law (2024 USD)
helped.source_name: UCLA Williams Institute — Bostock v. Clayton County Impact Report

pairs.arena: Executive & Police Impunity vs. Rule of Law & Accountability

harmed.case_name: Trump v. United States (Absolute Immunity) & Pierson/Harlow Qualified Immunity
harmed.author: John Roberts & Lewis Powell
harmed.ruling: Granted U.S. Presidents sweeping criminal immunity for official acts (Trump v. U.S.) and invented 'Qualified Immunity' shielding police and officials from civil rights lawsuits unless a prior court case had nearly identical facts.
harmed.human_cost: 57% of excessive-force appellate lawsuits are dismissed on Qualified Immunity grounds (Reuters investigation); U.S. police kill ~1,100–1,200 civilians per year (Black Americans at 2.6x the rate of white Americans).
harmed.dollar_cost_usd2024: $3.2 Billion+ paid by municipal taxpayers over 10 years for police misconduct settlements while offending officers and executives face near-zero personal liability (2024 USD)
harmed.source_name: Reuters Special Report — Shielded: How the Supreme Court Invented Qualified Immunity

helped.case_name: United States v. Nixon & Boumediene v. Bush
helped.author: Warren Burger & Anthony Kennedy
helped.ruling: Unanimously ruled that no President is above the law or immune from criminal subpoenas (forcing release of the Watergate tapes) and upheld constitutional habeas corpus against indefinite executive detention without trial (Boumediene).
helped.human_gain: Forced the resignation of a corrupt President within 16 days, triggered the post-Watergate ethics/FOIA/Inspector General laws, and preserved the ancient writ of habeas corpus.
helped.dollar_gain_usd2024: Inspector General reforms enacted after Nixon have recovered $180 Billion+ in federal fraud, waste, and abuse for taxpayers (CIGIE, 2024 USD)
helped.source_name: National Constitution Center — United States v. Nixon (1974)
